description: This file contains unit tests for the class 'Dropped' in the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging. It includes tests for creating an instance with null parameters and for monitoring and acknowledging dropped signals, utilizing mocking frameworks like Mockito and assertions via AssertJ.

classes.name: DroppedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the 'Dropped' class, testing instantiation and monitoring/acknowledgment behavior.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullSendingContext
methods.description: Tests that creating a 'Dropped' instance with null sending context throws NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Tests the 'monitorAndAcknowledge' method of the 'Dropped' class, verifying that it calls the monitor success method and returns an empty Optional when given null input.
